name: Korrupt Zombies
desc:
New lobby system! Unlock skin crates and matchmake easier with the terminal system and new UI.

Korrupt Zombies is a CoD Zombies-inspired round-based survival game. Team up with friends and fight off hordes of zombies on iconic maps with a huge arsenal of weapons. Experience breathtaking visuals and the most realistic graphics in the genre.

- Play on iconic maps like Five, Nacht and Town
- Discover easter eggs and find the Mystery Box, Pack-a-Punch, and more
- Massive arsenal of guns and 3 wonder weapons (Ray Gun, Winter's Howl, Thunder Gun)
- Upgrade your loadout with attachments and perks to enhance your firepower and survivability
- Customize your weapons with skins and cosmetics
- Grind and unlock exclusive camos 

--// Available on Mobile, PC and Console \\--

[P] to access settings and keybinds

Developed by: Axillary Studios
Published by: Roforco
